items.headline: Kahl Cheth Wins the Fall Classic at Tri-City — Bart Hecter Jr Clinches the 40th Anniversary Championship
items.snippet: Kahl Cheth won the main event at Tri-City's Fall Classic Championship Night in the 23 and scored 63 points, the best night in the field. He opened the season by winning the Apple Cup on this same track in April. The win pulled Cheth level with Jason Quatsoe's 8 on 580 for second in the championship, and the tie goes to Cheth on main-event finish: a win to Quatsoe's seventh. Bart Hecter Jr ran second in the main in the 68 and clinched the 2026 title on 616, 36 clear. Vince Conwell finished third in the main in the 82 and holds fourth on 539, 4 ahead of Shane Strimple's 57. Steve Woods set fast time in the 22. Hecter Jr also takes Rookie of the Year on 287. Thirteen cars took the green.

items.headline: The 68 Wins NASCAR Championship Night at Evergreen — Lead Grows to 27
items.snippet: The 68 took the main event at Evergreen's NASCAR Championship Night, banking the full 25 in the feature and 78 on the night, the best score in the field. Shane Strimple won his heat and finished second in the main in the 57, and Kahl Cheth ran third. Jason Quatsoe set fast time but finished sixth in the main, so the gap at the top grew: Bart Hecter Jr leads on 557, 27 up on Quatsoe's 8 and 40 clear of Cheth's 23. Bryan Roundtree had his best night of the year with 63, and S. Conduff scored 53 in the 31's first start. Fourteen cars took the green.

items.headline: Vince Conwell Wins Thunder in the Valley at Wenatchee
items.snippet: Vince Conwell took the 82 to the main event win at the Wenatchee Valley Super Oval, banking the full 25 in the feature and 69 on the night. Bart Hecter Jr had the bigger night overall — quick time and 75 points in the 68 — and leads on 479, fifteen up on Jason Quatsoe's 8 car at 464 and thirty-one clear of Kahl Cheth's 23 on 448. Two cars got on the board for the first time: D. Eierman won his heat in the 76 and left with 66, and K. Gill scored 54 in the 65.

items.headline: Bart Hecter Jr Sweeps Wenatchee — #68 Vaults to the Points Lead at the Apple Blossom Rubber Down
items.snippet: Round 3 of the 40th Anniversary tour ran at Wenatchee Valley Super Oval's quarter-mile. Bart Hecter Jr #68 swept the night — fast time, heat win, and the full 25 in the main — for 80 points on the day. The #68 jumped from 4th to the season lead at 211. Cheth #23 sits 9 back in second, Quatsoe #8 just two more behind in third. Steve Woods #22 didn't unload at Apple Blossom and dropped from 1st to 9th.

items.headline: Steve Woods Wins Grocery Outlet Night at Evergreen — Takes Over Points Lead
items.snippet: Round 2 of the 40th Anniversary tour ran at Evergreen Speedway. Steve Woods #22 dominated the half-mile to take the win and overtake the early points lead. Cheth #23 and Jones #30 rounded out the podium. The 17-car field set a tone — Woods would lead the standings for one week before Wenatchee reshuffled the deck.

items.headline: Kahl Cheth Wins the 57th Apple Cup at Tri-City to Open the 40th Anniversary Season
items.snippet: The 57th running of the Apple Cup opened VMRA's 40th Anniversary tour at Tri-City Raceway. Kahl Cheth #23 took the main event by the full 25-point margin, with Jason Quatsoe #8 second and Steve Woods #22 third. Defending champion Kyten Jones #30 did not unload on the night.

items.headline: Full 11-Date Tour Schedule Posted — 9 Points Rounds + 2 Specials
items.snippet: Apple Cup (done), Grocery Outlet Night (done), Apple Blossom Rubber Down (done), CARS Tour Mark Galloway Shootout, Ron Rohde Memorial at Stateline (non-points), the 40th Anniversary Bash at South Sound, two more Evergreen rounds, Thunder in the Valley at Wenatchee, NASCAR Championship Night, and the Fall Classic season finale.

items.snippet: Limited-run commemorative gear for sale by the tire trailer at every 2026 event. Cash or Venmo to the board.
